# Copilot instructions

The rules for every coding agent in this repo live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md): how work lands
(branch, `just ci`, draft PR, the Claude review gate), the `just` commands, the tests every change
needs, and what the code must protect (the owner's mail, credentials, corpus isolation). Follow it.
The review rubric is [`claude-review-prompt.md`](claude-review-prompt.md).
